question: How many of the sodium chlorate droplets tested at RH of about 33% and 34 C without a magnetic field formed single crystals?
rendered: According to Table 3, at RH ≈ 33% and T = 34 °C, 4 droplets were tested without a magnetic field. 4 of these 4 droplets formed single crystals, or 100%.
